subject: CAIQ: source-of-truth index and bulk evidence upload

Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ bulk evidence ask and a single control index

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for taking this on. We completed our first pass of the CAIQ and have a consolidated list of control IDs where we need artifacts or attestation. Rather than exchange dozens of individual files, would Redwood be able to:  

- Provide a single source-of-truth CSV/worksheet mapping CAIQ control ID -> Redwood artifact filename / retention window / control owner (if available)?
- Accept a bulk upload (SFTP or secure Drive) of evidence bundles mapped to that index?

We have an internal deadline for our board review the week of Nov 8, so the faster we can agree on the index and an intake method the better. I attached a short PDF that describes our requested format. If you already have a template, can you forward it?

Two small technical asks we expect from auditors: a sample of telemetry (keystore rotation logs and KV/cache eviction traces) for a 30-day window, and a short narrative that maps controls to runtime artifacts (e.g., which service writes the keys, which role rotates them).

Can you confirm expected timeline and a single point of contact on your side? Our security lead is on copy for follow-up.

Thanks,
Erin Malone
Senior Compliance Manager
NovaMed Health

Hi Erin —

Appreciate the clear ask and the deadline. We can definitely centralize this and will aim to deliver a staging index + upload path. High level plan:

1) We will produce a CAIQ control index CSV that includes: control_id, control_title, redwood_artifact_path (Drive/SFTP object name), artifact_owner (Redwood), retention_window_days, and any caveats.  (We will attach the template in our next message.)

2) For the telemetry samples you mentioned, Kimberly will extract a timeboxed snapshot of keystore rotation audit logs and the KV/cache eviction traces, redact tenant identifiers, and provide a hashed index so auditors can verify integrity. We will provide a short narrative mapping those artifacts back to control statements.

3) Upload mechanics: we can provide a secure folder in our Compliance Drive and a short transient SFTP link (preferring Drive for larger bundles). Once you confirm preference we will provision and share an upload checklist.

4) Timeline: initial index + intake link by end of day Thu, Oct 29. Telemetry samples and narratives by Fri, Nov 6 (which gives you a few days before Nov 8). If you need earlier, we can prioritize a partial handoff of high-risk controls.

Can you confirm: preferred transfer method (Drive or SFTP) and whether you want artifacts grouped by control ID or by artifact type?

I will attach the control index template in the next internal message so Kimberly has the schema we want to populate.

Best,
Irene Choi

- Telemetry extraction: I will run the keystore rotation audit export and kv-cache eviction traces for Oct 1–Oct 30 and place them in a quarantined bucket. We will pseudonymize tenant IDs and publish SHA256 checksums for integrity verification.
- Owners:

  * KV eviction traces: Diego Fernandez (diego.fernandez@redwood.com) — responsible for extraction and sample generation.

- Attachments we will provide: caiq_control_template.csv (schema above), sample_redaction_readme.md, telemetry_checksum_manifest.json.

If Novamed wants a per-control grouping in the upload folder we will create subfolders named by control ID. Otherwise we will upload a flattened bundle with the CSV index referencing artifact paths. My recommendation: subfolders (makes auditor navigation easier).

Irene — will start extraction tomorrow morning and aim to deliver the index by Thu EOD as discussed. Erin — if you can confirm Drive (preferred) and the account you want permissions granted to (email or service account), we will provision immediately.
